name: Da Nang
tagline: Beach, Mountains, and Bowl of Pho — Ultra-Affordable FIRE on Vietnam's Central Coast
description: Da Nang is rapidly emerging as Southeast Asia's most exciting FIRE destination. Perched between pristine beaches and the Marble Mountains, this coastal city delivers incredible food, warm weather, a growing expat scene, and a cost of living so low it almost feels like a cheat code. Vietnam's booming economy and improving infrastructure make Da Nang a forward-looking choice for retirees who want adventure and value in equal measure.

quickFacts.visa: 90-day e-Visa for US citizens (easily renewable). Vietnam is developing a retirement visa program but none exists yet. Long-term stays typically managed through tourist visa renewals or investor visa ($100K+).
quickFacts.safetyRating: Very Safe — extremely low violent crime, one of Vietnam's safest cities
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Da Nang International Airport (DAD) — 10 min from city center; direct flights to major Asian hubs
quickFacts.climate: Tropical monsoon with dry season (Feb-Aug) and wet season (Sep-Jan). Warm year-round with occasional typhoons in fall.

housing.description: Modern studio / 1BR near the An Thuong quarter or My Khe, or a smart local-district unit

dining.description: Street-food paradise (pho, banh mi, com tam), weekend seafood

healthcare.description: Individual regional/international basic plan (thin local market)

1M.lifestyle: A modern studio or one-bedroom near the An Thuong expat quarter or My Khe Beach, or a smart local-neighborhood unit. Eating is a street-food paradise — pho, banh mi, and com tam for a dollar or two — with weekend seafood by the water. A rented motorbike plus Grab covers mobility, and a regional/international health plan handles Da Nang's expanding private clinics. The beach and Marble Mountains are free; the trade-offs are limited English and a still-growing expat scene.

housing.description: Spacious 2-bedroom beachfront apartment or a modern villa in a quiet residential area with pool access

dining.description: Mix of incredible street food, upscale Vietnamese restaurants, international dining, and weekend seafood feasts

healthcare.description: Comprehensive private insurance covering top hospitals, dental included, annual health checks

transportation.description: Own motorbike plus regular Grab car rides, weekend road trips to Hoi An and Hue

entertainment.description: Gym membership, surfing lessons, weekend trips to Hoi An and the Ba Na Hills, Vietnamese cooking classes, scuba diving

2M.lifestyle: A spacious beachfront apartment or a modern unit with pool access, dining out regularly across good Vietnamese and international kitchens. A motorbike plus Grab, a broader international health plan with dental, and easy road trips to Hoi An and Hue. Morning swims at My Khe become part of the rhythm. Life is comfortable and relaxed. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Nice beachfront 1BR/2BR with pool and ocean views

dining.description: Da Nang's best regularly, with fresh seafood a staple

healthcare.description: Mid international/evacuation cover, Bangkok/Singapore for major work

transportation.description: Scooter and Grab, car rentals for coast drives, budget domestic flights

3M.lifestyle: A nice beachfront one- or two-bedroom with pool and ocean views, dining at Da Nang's best regularly with fresh seafood a staple. A scooter and Grab day to day, car rentals for drives up the coast, budget flights to Hanoi and Saigon, and a mid international plan with evacuation to Bangkok or Singapore. Golf and surf are close. A genuinely affluent coastal routine, tempered by Da Nang's still-limited fine-dining and entertainment depth.

housing.description: Stunning oceanfront estate in the Son Tra area or a luxury compound near My Khe with pool, gardens, and sea views

dining.description: Full-time private chef preparing Vietnamese and international cuisine, regular fine dining, curated wine collection

healthcare.description: VIP international coverage with Bumrungrad Bangkok access, personal physician, executive wellness programs

transportation.description: Luxury vehicle with part-time driver, domestic flights, private transfers, weekend road trips in comfort

entertainment.description: Premium golf memberships, private yacht charters to Cham Islands, art collecting, exclusive beach club access

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper/cook, part-time gardener, weekly laundry and deep cleaning service

luxuryExtras.description: Hoi An tailor-made wardrobe, private Vietnamese language tutor, premium spa memberships, charitable community projects

5M.lifestyle: A large oceanfront property near Son Tra or My Khe with pool and gardens, a housekeeper and cook for the home, and a premium car with a part-time driver. Business-class regional flights, regular travel across Vietnam, and VIP international health cover. This budget goes a very long way in Da Nang — daily life is very comfortable, though the city stays relatively small at the top end. (Interpolated tier.)

housing.description: Large villa with pool near My Khe beach

dining.description: Frequent fine dining (limited scene) plus a private chef sometimes

transportation.description: Luxury vehicle plus a driver, domestic flights

domesticHelp.description: Housekeeper/cook plus a part-time gardener for the residence

10M.lifestyle: A large villa with pool near My Khe beach, staffed by a housekeeper, an occasional cook, a gardener, and a driver. Comprehensive international concierge health cover, fine dining whenever it exists to be had, and first-class international travel. This is far more than Da Nang's market can absorb — you are at the top of what the coast offers, but it remains a mid-size Vietnamese city with a limited luxury ceiling; the beach and natural setting are the real draw.
